caption: Your planning should pull impact, not just tasks. This carousel shows five prompts to diagnose and upgrade your prioritisation. Use them to turn busywork into real progress. Which task on your plate would benefit most from an impact-first plan? #AI #Productivity #Prioritization #Entrepreneurs

slides.title: The urgency trap
slides.body: You prioritise by urgency and miss impact. Here are five prompts to reframe planning for real results.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose priority quality
slides.body: Task: Diagnose priority quality. Placeholder: Tasks: [paste tasks]. Output: ranked tasks with impact 1-5, effort 1-5, justification.

slides.title: 2. Improve prioritization
slides.body: Task: Improve prioritization. Placeholder: Tasks: [paste tasks]. Output: impact/effort matrix with quadrant labels; recommend next actions for top-right.

slides.title: 3. Plan a sprint
slides.body: Task: Plan a 1-week sprint. Placeholder: Tasks: [paste tasks]. Output: daily goals + 90-minute blocks; include buffers and owners.

slides.title: 4. Check value
slides.body: Task: Define success criteria. Placeholder: Goals: [paste objectives]. Output: 3 lightweight evaluation criteria and a simple feedback form.

slides.title: 5. Build reusable workflow
slides.body: Task: Build a reusable planning workflow. Placeholder: Template name. Output: a repeatable 4-step template and prompts for future cycles.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Takeaway: Prioritise by impact, not urgency, with a reusable 4-step planning workflow to finish higher-value work.
